title: An improved and convenient petri plate-based method for studying root growth in plants
author: Kaachra, Suri, et al.

steps.title: Assemble plate components
steps.instruction: Use a transparent square base plate (120 mm × 120 mm × 12 mm). Position two black glass pieces (118 mm × 5 mm) parallel to each other 40 mm from one side, leaving a 2 mm gap to form the upper black partition with a narrow horizontal aperture. Place a single black glass piece (118 mm × 5 mm) below the upper partition to form the lower partition. Attach small hinges on each side of the lower partition to support sterile tape and create a wider lower aperture. Seal both apertures with sterile tape before media pouring, and cover the root‑growing region with a self‑adhesive black film.

steps.title: Autoclave nutrient media
steps.instruction: Autoclave the two nutrient media formulations, designated Media‑I and Media‑II, to sterilize them.

steps.title: Cool media and seal apertures
steps.instruction: Allow both Media‑I and Media‑II to cool at room temperature until just before solidification, keeping the apertures sealed with sterile tape during cooling.

steps.title: Pour Media‑II into lower section
steps.instruction: In a laminar‑flow hood, pour the sterile Media‑II into the lower section of the assembled plate and let it solidify completely.

steps.title: Remove lower partition tape
steps.instruction: After Media‑II has solidified, use sterilized forceps to remove the sterile tape from the lower partition aperture.

steps.title: Pour Media‑I into upper section
steps.instruction: Pour sterile Media‑I into the upper section (between the upper and lower partitions) and allow it to solidify fully.

steps.title: Remove upper partition tape
steps.instruction: When Media‑I has solidified, remove the sterile tape covering the upper partition aperture.

steps.title: Place sterilized seeds
steps.instruction: Transfer sterilized seeds of Brassica juncea onto the aperture of the upper partition.

steps.title: Close plate and cover roots
steps.instruction: Close the plate with its cover plate, seal the edges with sterile surgical tape, and overlay the root‑growing region with the black film to maintain dark conditions for root growth.
